data.summary: Valkyr Prime is primarily designed for damage output with strong survivability through her Rage meter. She has some support capabilities and limited crowd control, but lacks stealth abilities. The role requires precise timing and execution of her abilities, adding a moderate level of complexity to the gameplay.
